title: ElevenLabs Voice Agent SDKs: React, JavaScript and Python
desc:
When the widget is not enough, the ElevenAgents SDKs let you build your own interface. This episode covers installing @elevenlabs/react, @elevenlabs/client and the elevenlabs Python package, a minimal React agent with ConversationProvider and the granular hooks, how private agents get a conversation token or signed URL from your server without exposing the API key, WebRTC vs WebSocket, the methods for text input, context and feedback, and a complete Python script.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
